evidence.title: Introducing Lumeria: Your Skin, Finally Understood
evidence.publisher: Introducing Lumeria: Your Skin, Finally Understood
evidence.excerpt: Everyone owns skincare products, but nobody knows what's actually working. Your skin reacts to everything in your daily life: your sleep, stress, water, products, even the humidity in the air. Nothing has ever captured any of it. The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and sun damage years before it shows. Every scan is scored on…
